newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bogota airport snarled by wayward cargo plane.
newsitem.headline: Bogota airport snarled by wayward cargo plane.

text.p: A Boeing 727 cargo plane skidded off the only runway at Bogota's El Dorado International airport on Wednesday, forcing authorities to restrict flights for more than 12 hours.

Pilots of the Aerosucre jet, who were heading for the Caribbean city of Barranquilla, aborted takeoff because of problems with their landing gear, sending the plane nose down into a grassy security zone off the end of the tarmac, airport director Francisco Hernandez told Reuters.
None of the three-man crew was injured.
A second runway is currently under construction at El Dorado but it is not due to open until August 1998.
